description.value: Kojima Sushi is a sushi restaurant on Commercial Drive in Vancouver, serving a broad menu of rolls, sashimi, nigiri, oshi sushi, bento combos, and Japanese appetizers. The restaurant is noted for its Salmon Oshi Sushi and creative specialty rolls, and handles a high volume of online orders. Both dine-in and pickup are available through the Zomi platform.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Zomi ordering platform page confirms the address as 1836 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, BC V5N 4A5, matching OSM. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered ('Pickup 15–20 min Free') and the menu lists dedicated vegetarian sections ('Chef's Veggie Roll', 'Vegetarian items', 'Veg Combo A', tofu dishes), confirming vegetarian options. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: The AI-generated review summary on the Zomi page incorrectly states the restaurant is 'located on Main Street in Vancouver' — this contradicts both OSM and the address shown elsewhere on the same page (1836 Commercial Dr). This appears to be an error in the platform's auto-generated text, not a real address discrepancy.
The listed website is a third-party food ordering platform (zomi.menu), not the restaurant's own domain. No independent restaurant website was found in OSM tags or website content.
Phone number from OSM (+1-604-216-6799) could not be confirmed from the scraped website text, which only shows a 'Call' button without displaying the number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible sushi restaurant on a major cycling corridor (Commercial Drive) in Vancouver, confirmed active as of the OSM check date of 2026-02-16.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Chef's Veggie Roll (8pcs)' section, 'Vegetarian items' label, Veg Combo A, Vegetable Box, Tofu Teriyaki Box, Agedashi Tofu, Spicy Tofu, Vegetable Gyoza, and Veggie Spring Roll
